$comment: Inputs for stuck-watch.sh, deadman.sh and stuck-audit.sh. Every key is overridable by an SW_* env var or a flag (Design principles 101 item 17). Owner, 2026-10-16 UTC: 'what really ensure things are stuck? i dont trust you or agents or humans' and 'ensure it goes to my phone'. codes is the status code map: what each code means and who acts.

STK-001.means: seat idle longer than idle_seconds and no result file

STK-002.means: no commit on the seat's branch and no PR change for stale_minutes, no result file

STK-003.means: seat CPU 0 for cpu_zero_samples consecutive ticks, no result file

STK-005.means: result claims done but gh shows a PR not merged or CI not green

STK-090.means: stuck-watch dead: heartbeat older than heartbeat_max_seconds

STK-091.acts: architect break glass: bring the bus up

STK-092.means: Bearings server of a live line down: probe of 127.0.0.1:<port>/state returned 000, or no server.json
STK-092.acts: architect break glass: make -C claude/workflow bearings-up LINE=<line>

A2A-004.means: SOP breach recorded in a result file, paged as is

QUEUED-STALE.means: seat has queued input unchanged for pane_look.queued_stale_s

IDLE-STALE.means: seat pane idle (no moving spinner) for pane_look.idle_stale_s and no result file
